marta: evening swap — quick watchlist for next 12h. copying latest checks. TL;DR: prefetch jitter on kv-cache, noisy heartbeat alerts in eu, encoder pool trending up but under threshold. Steps below.

lee: ack. I'll keep an eye on kv prefetch. where's current runbook?

marta: runbook: /playbooks/kv-prefetch -> step 3 is manual drain if >15% miss rate. Current metrics: miss_rate ~12-13% median, spike to 18% around 18:40 UTC. Quick query to check:

```bash
curl -s 'https://metrics.internal/api?metric=kv_prefetch_miss&range=10m' | jq .
```

oncall-bot: Alert suppressions: kv-prefetch-flap suppressed 15m ago (rule: prefetch-fuzzy) — acknowledged by marta. Suppression window ends at 1945010400.

sam: FYI: encoder pool CPU bumped to 78% on gpu-enc-3 right before the prefetch spike. I scaled encoder pool +1 replica. Monitoring.

deb: noted. I'll mute the noisy heartbeat in eu for the night, devex informed. Any public-facing impact?

marta: no customer-facing errors observed. Tail latency for some batch jobs up ~50ms. If you see 5xxs, page eng-sre.

lee: leaving canary routing on; if p95 latency >200ms for 3m, flip traffic to fallback per routing runbook.

sam: sharing quick dashboard: https://dashboards.internal/redwood/shift/1945 — bumped pager threshold for kv-prefetch to 10% while we observe.

marta: small heads-up: prefetch cache TTL patch scheduled tomorrow 09:00 PT. Rollback plan: revert PR #4213 if regressions after midnight. Thanks all :wave:
